plugin_desc: By collecting metrics such as Nginx requests, connection status, and processing efficiency, this helps monitor and optimize the website's performance and stability.
name: Nginx

metrics.name: nginx_active
metrics.description: Number of active client connections, reflecting concurrent load

metrics.name: nginx_reading
metrics.description: Number of connections reading request headers, reflecting request processing status

metrics.name: nginx_writing
metrics.description: Number of connections writing responses, reflecting response processing status

metrics.name: nginx_waiting
metrics.description: Number of idle connections waiting for requests, reflecting connection pool usage

metrics.name: nginx_http_requests_total
metrics.description: Total number of HTTP requests handled by Nginx.

metrics.name: nginx_connections_accepted
metrics.description: Client connections accepted by Nginx.

metrics.name: nginx_connections_handled
metrics.description: Client connections handled by Nginx.

metrics.name: nginx_up
metrics.description: 1 when stub_status collection succeeds, and 0 when it fails.

metrics.name: nginx_requests_rate
metrics.description: Average requests handled per second over the last 5 minutes.

metrics.name: nginx_accepts_rate
metrics.description: Average new connections accepted per second over the last 5 minutes.

metrics.name: nginx_handled_rate
metrics.description: Average connections handled per second over the last 5 minutes.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_server_connections
metrics.description: Connection counts grouped by status.
metrics.query: alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_connections_active{__$labels__}, "status", "active", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_connections") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_connections_reading{__$labels__}, "status", "reading", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_connections") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_connections_writing{__$labels__}, "status", "writing", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_connections") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_connections_waiting{__$labels__}, "status", "waiting", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_connections") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_connections_accepted{__$labels__}, "status", "accepted", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_connections") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_connections_handled{__$labels__}, "status", "handled", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_connections") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_connections_requests{__$labels__}, "status", "requests", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_connections")

metrics.name: nginx_vts_server_requests
metrics.description: Requests per server zone, counted by response status code.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_server_bytes
metrics.description: Inbound or outbound bytes for each server zone.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_server_cache
metrics.description: Requests per server zone, counted by cache result.
metrics.query: alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_server_cache_miss{__$labels__}, "status", "miss", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_server_cache_bypass{__$labels__}, "status", "bypass", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_server_cache_expired{__$labels__}, "status", "expired", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_server_cache_stale{__$labels__}, "status", "stale", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_server_cache_updating{__$labels__}, "status", "updating", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_server_cache_revalidated{__$labels__}, "status", "revalidated", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_server_cache_hit{__$labels__}, "status", "hit", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_server_cache_scarce{__$labels__}, "status", "scarce", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_server_cache")

metrics.name: nginx_vts_server_requestMsec
metrics.description: Average request processing time for each server zone.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_filter_requests
metrics.description: Requests per filter, counted by response status code.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_filter_bytes
metrics.description: Inbound or outbound bytes for each filter.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_filter_requestMsec
metrics.description: Average request processing time for each filter.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_filter_cache
metrics.description: Requests per filter, counted by cache result.
metrics.query: alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_filter_cache_miss{__$labels__}, "status", "miss", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_filter_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_filter_cache_bypass{__$labels__}, "status", "bypass", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_filter_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_filter_cache_expired{__$labels__}, "status", "expired", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_filter_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_filter_cache_stale{__$labels__}, "status", "stale", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_filter_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_filter_cache_updating{__$labels__}, "status", "updating", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_filter_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_filter_cache_revalidated{__$labels__}, "status", "revalidated", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_filter_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_filter_cache_hit{__$labels__}, "status", "hit", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_filter_cache") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_filter_cache_scarce{__$labels__}, "status", "scarce", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_filter_cache")

metrics.name: nginx_vts_upstream_requests
metrics.description: Requests per upstream server, counted by response status code.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_upstream_bytes
metrics.description: Inbound or outbound bytes for each upstream server.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_upstream_requestMsec
metrics.description: Average request processing time for each upstream server.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_upstream_responseMsec
metrics.description: Average response time for each upstream server.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_upstream_down
metrics.description: Whether the upstream server is marked down.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_upstream_backup
metrics.description: Whether the upstream server is a backup server.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_upstream_weight
metrics.description: Load weight of the upstream server.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_upstream_max_fails
metrics.description: Maximum failures allowed for the upstream server.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_upstream_fail_timeout
metrics.description: Pause duration after the upstream server reaches its failure limit.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_cache_max_bytes
metrics.description: Capacity limit of the cache zone.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_cache_used_bytes
metrics.description: Space used by the cache zone.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_cache_bytes
metrics.description: Inbound or outbound bytes for the cache zone.

metrics.name: nginx_vts_cache_responses
metrics.description: Requests in the cache zone, counted by cache result.
metrics.query: alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_cache_miss{__$labels__}, "status", "miss", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_cache_responses") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_cache_bypass{__$labels__}, "status", "bypass", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_cache_responses") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_cache_expired{__$labels__}, "status", "expired", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_cache_responses") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_cache_stale{__$labels__}, "status", "stale", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_cache_responses") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_cache_updating{__$labels__}, "status", "updating", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_cache_responses") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_cache_revalidated{__$labels__}, "status", "revalidated", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_cache_responses") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_cache_hit{__$labels__}, "status", "hit", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_cache_responses") or alias(label_replace(nginx_vts_cache_scarce{__$labels__}, "status", "scarce", "__name__", ".*"), "nginx_vts_cache_responses")
